{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
PROBLEM: Recurring lock timeout issues manifesting as lock waits tripping statement timeout

FOUR SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

OCCASION 1 - [2026-01-19]
TRIGGER: Lock timeout appeared only for sessions arriving through OAuth provider
ROOT CAUSE: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
FIX: Raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue in front of it
PR/BRANCH: #1680 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1
RESULT: Throughput rose 89%, to 586 requests per second
REPRO: Run migration against loaded table

OCCASION 2 - [2026-04-18]
TRIGGER: Lock timeout appeared only when two requests raced on same key
ROOT CAUSE: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
FIX: Capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
PR/BRANCH: #4493 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2
RESULT: Flaky test went from 30 failures per hundred runs to zero
REPRO: Run migration against loaded table

OCCASION 3 - [2026-08-01]
TRIGGER: Lock timeout appeared only after client had already retried once
ROOT CAUSE: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
FIX: Prefetched relation in single query
PR/BRANCH: #6157 on branch fix/lock-timeout-3
RESULT: Cold start dropped 3%, to 307 ms
REPRO: Run migration against loaded table

OCCASION 4 - [2026-08-03]
TRIGGER: Lock timeout appeared after rolling restart of fleet
ROOT CAUSE: Config loader reading wrong environment file
FIX: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR/BRANCH: #6624 on branch fix/lock-timeout-4
RESULT: Backlog cleared 74 minutes after deploy
STACK: SQL
COVERING CHECK: Migration dry run in CI

CONTEXT: All occasions share same signal (lock wait tripping statement timeout) and same repro method, indicating this migration has been susceptible to different classes of lock contention issues under different operational conditions."}
